parameters.formDescription: Produce a set of visual assets from one source text.

nodes.name: execute_author
nodes.notes: A failed or unconfigured authoring call must not block the other assets, so the error is continued and agent_result turns the missing binary into that asset's ERROR. See agent_result.notes and the 'continueRegularOutput makes a failure invisible' rule in AGENTS.md.

nodes.name: store_artifact
nodes.notes: The session's finished artifact, stored by the temp-bucket server; continued on error for the same reason as execute_author, and agent_result reports it as this asset's ERROR.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method: 'tools/call', params: { name: 'temp_store', arguments: { source_url: $('build_author_brief').item.json.ARTIFACT_URL, key: $('build_author_brief').item.json.ARTIFACT_KEY } } }) }}

nodes.name: store_paired_artifact
nodes.notes: The deck's paired video, stored after the deck. Continued on error for the same reason as store_artifact: agent_result keeps the deck and reports the missing pair rather than failing the run.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method: 'tools/call', params: { name: 'temp_store', arguments: { source_url: $('build_author_brief').item.json.PAIRED_ARTIFACT_URL, key: $('build_author_brief').item.json.PAIRED_ARTIFACT_KEY } } }) }}
